translations.translatedText: # Monday 2.5.2022 (radio)
A strike in municipal sector begins. No Russian nuclear power plant will come to Pyhäjoki. Employment improved in March. Yle publishes news in Ukrainian. The weather.
## Strike in the municipal sector

![Day-care children play in the yard of Touhula day-care centre.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_4913,h_2763,x_0,y_218/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-88481961a0dd902a697/1723621598)
Open image viewer
The strike in the municipal sector can close day-care centres. Photo: Antti Kolppo / Yle
A big strike in the municipal sector begins tomorrow.

In total, about 80 000 workers will go on strike in 10 different towns. Municipal sector workers are on strike, for example, in the Helsinki region, in Tampere, Turku, Oulu and Rovaniemi. The strike lasts one week.
Because of the strike, many schools and day-care centres are closed. The strike also affects the work of libraries, for example. Nurses, however, are not part of this strike
The reason for the strike is money. The employer and the employees are in a dispute about wages.
## Nuclear power plant of Fennovoima

![Activities that support the construction of the Hanhikivi 1 power plant.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_2046,h_1150,x_0,y_85/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-9128986204a38290db4/1644471356)
Open image viewer
The construction site of the Hanhikivi nuclear power plant in Pyhäjoki. Photo: Fennovoima
The energy company Fennovoima has cancelled the nuclear power plant contract with the Russian Rosatom. Rosatom was supposed to deliver the nuclear reactor for Fennovoima's power plant in Pyhäjoki.

Fennovoima justifies cancelling the contract by saying that Rosatom is not able to carry out the nuclear power plant project. Fennovoima says that the war in Ukraine has also made the project's risks worse.
Cancelling the contract means that the work at the Hanhikivi nuclear power plant construction site in Pyhäjoki will end.
## Employment rises
![Olivia Arnell working at a checkout counter](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_6000,h_3375,x_0,y_309/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-7244685f734ed99c8ed/1601392385)
Open image viewer
In retail, a lot of part-time work is done. Photo: Minna Rosvall / Yle
Employment improved in March.
Statistics Finland says that in March there were 77 000 more people in work than a year earlier. The employment rate was almost 74 per cent.
Juho Keskinen, economist at Hypo, says that the employment rate was last this high before the recession of the 1990s.

Keskinen says that the high employment rate is due, for example, to the large number of fixed-term and part-time workers. It is also explained by the fact that the economy has finally opened up, now that the corona restrictions have ended.
Keskinen says that the war in Ukraine is not yet showing in the Finnish labour market, at least.
## News in Ukrainian
![Yle, Pasila link tower](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5831,h_3282,x_0,y_55/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/17-7636358afd04bee9e8/1487917368)
Open image viewer
Yle publishes news in Ukrainian every weekday. Photo: Derrick Frilund / Yle
Yle starts publishing news in the Ukrainian language online.
The first news in Ukrainian will be published the day after tomorrow, on Wednesday. News in Ukrainian will be published every weekday.
The purpose of the service is to offer Ukrainians news and other important information in their own mother tongue.
It is estimated that as many as 80 000 Ukrainian refugees may come to Finland.
## Tuesday's weather
![Map of the weather in Finland](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-12426598)
Open image viewer
Photo: Yle
Tomorrow it is cold and windy across the whole country.
In places there will be snow or sleet showers, but for the most part it is dry.
The temperature during the day is between -2 in the north and +8 in the south.
